title_zh: 京张上街 v2.2：三处首发100米与一套可逆构件
title_en: Jing-Zhang AI MAIN STREET v2.2: three first-use 100-m studies and one reversible kit
boundary_note_zh: 每处均为代表性的100米概念研究窗口，不是官方片区边界、道路红线、实测总平面、工程尺寸、投资或实施承诺；须在正式数据、权属、遗产、交通、消防、市政、运营授权与专业审查后深化。
boundary_note_en: Each is a representative 100-m concept study window, not an official area boundary, road line, surveyed plan, engineering dimension, investment or delivery commitment. It requires official data, ownership, heritage, transport, fire, utility, operating-authority and professional review before development.

components.title_en: Street Pass and low-light status board
components.function_zh: 现场显示用途、状态、责任角色、非AI入口、暂停或退场原因。
components.function_en: Shows purpose, status, accountable roles, the non-AI entry and reasons for pause or exit on site.
components.ai_off_zh: 保留普通导视、人工服务时间和申诉入口。
components.ai_off_en: Keeps ordinary wayfinding, staffed hours and appeal access.

components.function_zh: 提供需求拆解、人工说明、复核、申诉和纸面等价服务。
components.function_en: Provides need framing, human explanation, review, appeal and an equivalent paper service.
components.ai_off_zh: 继续作为普通咨询与社区服务台。
components.ai_off_en: Continues as an ordinary information and community-service desk.

components.title_zh: 双高可达台与实体地图
components.title_en: Dual-height accessible counter and physical map
components.function_zh: 让轮椅使用者、儿童、长者和无智能设备者完成同一流程。
components.function_en: Lets wheelchair users, children, older people and people without smart devices complete the same process.
components.ai_off_zh: 保留无App导向、等候和纸面办理。
components.ai_off_en: Keeps no-app wayfinding, waiting and paper handling.

components.function_zh: 用可移动桌、软隔离、地贴和限定电源承载短时试验。
components.function_en: Holds time-limited trials with movable tables, soft barriers, floor marks and bounded power.
components.ai_off_zh: 恢复为休息、共读、店前经营或普通活动面。
components.ai_off_en: Returns to seating, shared reading, ordinary shopfront use or everyday activity.

components.function_zh: 把人工接管、停机、工具和检修责任放在现场可见处。
components.function_en: Makes human takeover, shutdown, tools and maintenance responsibility visible on site.
components.ai_off_zh: 转为普通公共设施检修与储物点。
components.ai_off_en: Becomes an ordinary public-facility maintenance and storage point.

components.function_zh: 收纳试验物件、纸面替代材料与普通空间恢复清单。
components.function_en: Stores trial objects, paper alternatives and the ordinary-space restoration checklist.
components.ai_off_zh: 公开退场原因、恢复检查和删除/撤回回执。
components.ai_off_en: Publishes the exit reason, restoration check and deletion or withdrawal receipt.

prototypes.question_zh: 能否在不挤占普通通行的前提下安全工作？
prototypes.question_en: Can it work safely without displacing ordinary movement?
plan_sequence_zh: 连续树荫与无障碍日常底板
plan_sequence_en: C1 status board and C2 safety desk
C5 rear emergency stop and maintenance
C6 exit storage and restored surface

flows.public_zh: 行人、轮椅与骑行者沿公共底板直行，不穿越验证环。
flows.public_en: Pedestrians, wheelchair users and cyclists continue on the public base without crossing the loop.
flows.service_zh: 设备只在环内闭合运行；维护从后场进入C5。
flows.service_en: Equipment circulates only inside the loop; maintenance reaches C5 from the rear.
flows.failure_zh: 故障时设备沿最短回收线进入C6，公共流线保持连续。
flows.failure_en: On failure, equipment follows the shortest recovery route to C6 while public movement remains continuous.

states.zh: 日常：花园步行、观察、休憩；验证设备收纳。
states.en: DAILY: garden walking, observation and rest; test equipment is stored.

states.zh: 试验：限定时段、围栏内、现场安全员可见的低速运行。
states.en: TEST: low-speed operation within a bounded window and the visible reach of a safety steward.

states.zh: 故障：实体急停、状态转粉、人工引导保持外侧通行。
states.en: FAILURE: physical stop, pink status and human guidance keep the outside route open.

states.zh: 退场：设备与围栏入C6，恢复树荫、座椅与普通活动。
states.en: EXIT: equipment and barriers return to C6; shade, seating and ordinary activity are restored.

stop_conditions_zh: 无法撤除设备恢复通行
stop_conditions_en: A collision or near miss is not reported
Equipment cannot be removed to restore movement
prototypes.ai_off_zh: 一处完整的花园、观察廊和安全咨询点。
prototypes.ai_off_en: A complete garden, observation porch and safety-information point.

prototypes.name_en: AI Origin Translation Street House and Courtyard
prototypes.question_zh: 普通人能否理解、拒绝、修正并安全采用？
prototypes.question_en: Can ordinary people understand, refuse, correct and safely adopt it?
plan_sequence_zh: C3模型卡墙与实体服务图
共测廊、C4移动桌与社区院
plan_sequence_en: No-app street entry and C1 status board
C3 model-card wall and physical service map
Co-test porch, C4 movable tables and community yard
C6 exit to ordinary community service

flows.public_zh: 居民、人才与访客可沿街—廊—院环行，不经过静室。
flows.public_en: Residents, talent and visitors can loop from street to porch to yard without entering the quiet room.
flows.service_zh: 问题从人工窗进入共测，结果以普通语言和纸面卡返回。
flows.service_en: Questions enter through the human desk and return from co-testing as plain-language paper cards.
flows.failure_zh: 撤回与申诉直接返回C2，数字服务停止而人工流程继续。
flows.failure_en: Withdrawal and appeal return directly to C2; digital service stops while the human route continues.

states.zh: 日常：咨询、共读、休息与社区活动；共测桌收纳。
states.en: DAILY: information, shared reading, rest and community activity; co-test tables are stored.

states.zh: 试验：预约小样本共测，目的、限制和人工责任现场公开。
states.en: TEST: booked small-sample co-testing with purpose, limits and human responsibility published on site.

states.zh: 故障：停止对话与屏幕，转入纸面/人工服务和更正流程。
states.en: FAILURE: dialogue and screens stop; paper/human service and correction take over.

states.zh: 退场：C4回收，模型卡、人工咨询和院落活动持续。
states.en: EXIT: C4 is removed while model cards, human information and courtyard activity continue.

stop_conditions_zh: 不能用普通语言说明用途、局限、责任与撤回
没有人工解释或等价服务
强制使用AI或持续身份追踪
stop_conditions_en: Purpose, limits, responsibility and withdrawal cannot be explained in plain language
No human explanation or equivalent service
AI is forced or identity is continuously tracked
The accessible main route is interrupted
prototypes.ai_off_zh: 一处人才与居民共享的咨询、共读、休息和社区院落。
prototypes.ai_off_en: A shared information, reading, resting and community courtyard for residents and talent.

prototypes.name_zh: 大钟寺首用市集与站前角
prototypes.name_en: Dazhongsi First-use Market and Station Corner
prototypes.question_zh: 真实小微组织能否持续使用、纠错并退出？
prototypes.question_en: Can a real small organisation keep using, correcting and exiting it?
plan_sequence_zh: 站点方向连续步行与等候底板
C4小店、多语内容与维修轮换桌
商户确认、删除与撤回窗
plan_sequence_en: Continuous walking and waiting base toward transit
C1 status board and C2 human desk
C4 rotating shop, multilingual-content and repair tables
Merchant confirmation, deletion and withdrawal window
C5 light-maintenance cabinet and C6 exit cart

flows.public_zh: 通勤、购物与无障碍主线直行，不穿越试用桌。
flows.public_en: Commuting, shopping and accessible movement continues straight without crossing trial tables.
flows.service_zh: 商户问题经人工拆解、限时试用、最终确认后返回经营。
flows.service_en: A merchant question passes through human framing, time-limited use and final confirmation before returning to business.
flows.failure_zh: 撤回直达删除回执，桌面断电，普通经营模板立即接管。
flows.failure_en: Withdrawal leads directly to a deletion receipt; tables power off and the ordinary business template takes over.

states.zh: 日常：通勤、坐等、店前经营、人工与纸面服务。
states.en: DAILY: commuting, waiting, shopfront trade and human/paper service.

states.zh: 试验：限定时段、商户和工作人员共同确认的可选首用。
states.en: TEST: optional first use in a defined window, co-confirmed by the merchant and staff.

states.zh: 故障：状态转粉、桌面断电、纸面经营模板接管。
states.en: FAILURE: status turns pink, tables power off and paper business templates take over.

states.zh: 退场：试用桌收纳，保留经营、等候、维修与人工多语服务。
states.en: EXIT: trial tables are stored; trade, waiting, repair and human multilingual service remain.

stop_conditions_zh: 建议无法解释或商户不同意
stop_conditions_en: Advice cannot be explained or the merchant does not agree
prototypes.ai_off_zh: 一处可经营、等候、维修、会面和获得人工多语服务的普通店前空间。
prototypes.ai_off_en: An ordinary shopfront for trade, waiting, repair, meeting and human multilingual service.

journey.persona_zh: 林岚：合成、非识别性角色；大钟寺小店经营者兼照护者
journey.persona_en: Lin Lan: a composite, non-identifying shopkeeper and caregiver in Dazhongsi
journey.problem_zh: 希望改善多语商品说明与无障碍到店信息，不上传顾客身份。
journey.problem_en: Wants better multilingual product information and accessible arrival guidance without uploading customer identity.

steps.title_zh: 遗址公园先保证普通到达
steps.title_en: The heritage park first guarantees ordinary arrival
steps.result_zh: 无App导向、遮荫座椅、实体地图与人工求助先成立。
steps.result_en: No-app wayfinding, shaded seating, a physical map and human help work first.

steps.title_en: Zhongzhiyuan decides whether it may be tested
steps.result_zh: 范围、急停、近失和撤场线清楚；失败也是有效结果。
steps.result_en: Boundary, emergency stop, near miss and exit route are clear; failure is a valid result.

steps.title_zh: 原点社区决定能不能听懂
steps.title_en: AI Origin decides whether people can understand it
steps.result_zh: 林岚能复述用途、局限、人工责任和撤回方法才盖章。
steps.result_en: The stamp is given only if Lin can restate purpose, limits, human responsibility and withdrawal.

steps.title_zh: 大钟寺决定能不能真实采用
steps.title_en: Dazhongsi decides whether it can be adopted in real use
steps.result_zh: 限时、脱敏、人工在场；店主确认、删除回执和非AI模板齐全。
steps.result_en: Time-limited, minimised and staffed; merchant confirmation, deletion receipt and non-AI template are complete.

steps.title_zh: 公众决定扩展、暂停还是退场
steps.title_en: The public decides expansion, pause or exit
steps.result_zh: 成功、暂停和失败同权记录；桌子撤走后普通经营继续。
steps.result_en: Success, pause and failure are recorded equally; ordinary trade continues after tables leave.

roles.zh: 受影响使用者（含长者、残障者、商户）
roles.en: Affected users, including older and disabled people and merchants

roles.zh: 可被授权的运营责任人

co_review.rule_zh: 任何一方均可提出暂停；扩展不得由提案者或运营者单独决定。
co_review.rule_en: Any party may request a pause; expansion cannot be decided by the proposer or operator alone.

evidence_cards.zh: 可达：无App路线与人工援助是否可用
evidence_cards.en: Access: whether the no-app route and human help work

evidence_cards.zh: 可理解：能否复述边界、责任与退出
evidence_cards.en: Understanding: whether limits, responsibility and exit can be restated

evidence_cards.zh: 安全维护：急停、近失关闭与普通空间复原
evidence_cards.en: Safety and maintenance: stop, near-miss closure and ordinary-space restoration

evidence_cards.zh: 公平收益：问题来源、回流、申诉、纠正与删除回执
evidence_cards.en: Fair value: problem origin, return, appeal, correction and deletion receipt

delivery_horizons.boundary_zh: 概念成熟序列，不是获批工期。
delivery_horizons.boundary_en: A conceptual maturity sequence, not an approved programme.

delivery_horizons.boundary_zh: 只有使用者、维护者与专业复核共同通过才扩展。
delivery_horizons.boundary_en: Expansion follows only joint user, maintainer and professional review.

delivery_horizons.boundary_zh: 每个新点位重新授权，不以一次试点替代。
delivery_horizons.boundary_en: Every new site is authorised again; one pilot does not authorise the network.

action_packages.h1_zh: 纸质票、人工台、停机演练
action_packages.h1_en: Paper pass, human desk, shutdown drill
action_packages.h2_zh: 统一状态字段与申诉回执
action_packages.h2_en: Shared status fields and appeal receipt
action_packages.gate_zh: 无现场人、非AI路线或停机演练则不启用
action_packages.gate_en: No launch without on-site staff, a non-AI route and a shutdown drill

action_packages.h2_zh: 安全数据通过后的可控环
action_packages.gate_zh: 近失闭环、接管与撤场复原
action_packages.gate_en: Near-miss closure, takeover and restored exit

action_packages.h3_zh: 逐商户重新同意后复制
action_packages.gate_zh: 商户确认、删除回执与普通模板
action_packages.gate_en: Merchant confirmation, deletion receipt and ordinary template

action_packages.h1_zh: 物理路线审计与人工协助
action_packages.h2_zh: 断点闭合后的自愿AI建议
action_packages.h2_en: Optional AI advice after gaps close
action_packages.gate_zh: 主链连通、响应与无App可达
action_packages.gate_en: Connected main route, response and no-app access

action_packages.h1_zh: 双高台、低亮状态与维修门样段
action_packages.gate_zh: 不占通道、可关闭、有人维护
action_packages.gate_en: No route obstruction, switchable and maintained

action_packages.gate_zh: 证据、许可、版本与更正入口
action_packages.gate_en: Evidence, licence, version and correction access

action_packages.h1_zh: 一次问题征集与一次共测
action_packages.h1_en: One problem call and one co-test
action_packages.gate_zh: 公开档案、失败复盘与退出路线
action_packages.gate_en: Public archive, failure review and exit route

heritage_kit.zh: 双平行嵌线：铁路+数据的连续导向，不作炫光
heritage_kit.en: Twin inlaid lines: rail-plus-data wayfinding without spectacle lighting

heritage_kit.zh: 深色可维修边框：承载状态、版本与责任
heritage_kit.en: Dark repairable frame: carries status, version and responsibility

heritage_kit.zh: 可替换搪瓷/金属牌：像时刻牌而非巨屏
heritage_kit.en: Replaceable enamel/metal plate: like a timetable, not a giant screen

heritage_kit.zh: 轨枕尺度坐凳/树池边：仅借用尺度语言，不挪用遗存
heritage_kit.en: Sleeper-scale bench/tree edge: a scale reference, not reused heritage fabric

heritage_kit.zh: 低亮琥珀安全灯：表示暂停与人工接管
heritage_kit.en: Low-glare amber safety light: signals pause and human takeover

heritage_kit.zh: 可拆遮棚、桌与双高柜台：每件可收纳、修复和退出
heritage_kit.en: Demountable canopy, table and dual-height desk: each can be stored, repaired and exited
